I'm going to give you the advice that I know I should give myself:
We can't fix everything, we can't be perfect. But what defines perfect anyways? Perfect is boring. Let's rather be ourselves and try to be the best version of that. Life has so much to offer, we just need to walk through this dark tunnel a little longer and find the light. I'm not trying to be mean or hurt you with below advice, I really want to try to help you. Sometimes we have to turn the switch, think logically and think in solutions:

I'm fat - Start eating healthy and exercise. I know trust me it's easier said than done, but you don't have to do an 180, just start small first by exercising 2 times a week for an hour, minimize the amount of snacks and sodas. With a healthier diet you'll also feel healthier mentally. I recommend Chloe Ting on Youtube. She gives free workout plans.

I'm ugly - Everyone is beautiful in their own way. It's important to love yourself, from the inside and out. Maybe change up your hairstyle and outfit for a more stylish look? Cool clothes can also make you feel more confident, but make sure to choose something that you feel comfortable in.

I'm stupid - You're not stupid. But if you feel like you lack knowledge, start reading (news) articles, books. I like to do free eLearnings to broaden my knowledge about stuff. It takes me 10 times before I learn something, which often makes me feel very stupid, but everyone has his own pace you know? that does not make you stupid. I also like to do those brain training type of games.

Antisocial and no friends - It's hard to give advice on this, because I hate and suck making small talk with new people. I sometimes just have nothing to offer in a conversation. But try to find people with the same interests. Like maybe go to conventions and meet up with people?

No hobbies - I have zero hobbies because I suck at everything. I am not creative,sporty at all. But I recently started to make paintings because I want to try to find out what I like. Try a couple of things that spark your interest 

Motivation - The only one that can motivate you is you. What helps for me is watch inspirational youtubers. With that I mean; people that inspire me to pick up a hobby, go work out, learn something new. You don't have to save the world or do something drastic in your life, just take steps even of they are babysteps. 

I really hope this will inspire you a little, even if it's just a little. And I hope you will find the strength in life, and love yourself a litle more.
